title: Large filtered-colimit continuity of Ext sheaf cohomology
statement: Let X be a qcqs scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], A a small filtered category with objects and morphisms in Type(u+1), D a diagram of abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], c a colimit cocone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and q a natural number. Then the image of c under the existing functor Sheaf.functorH X.smallEtaleTopology q, whose values are Ext from the constant integer sheaf [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], is a colimit cocone. No torsion assumption is needed.

source.place: 03Q5 and 0739; comparison with Ext, 015A and 05TI; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03Q5

proof.text: Repeat the proof of filtered-colimit continuity of derived etale cohomology at the coefficient universe u+1: the qcqs finite-cover argument and exactness of filtered colimits apply to diagrams in this universe as well. Index size must be treated explicitly; the smaller-index existing theorem cannot simply be specialized. Use functorial injective diagrams, Cech acyclicity of their colimit, and induction with long exact sequences, as described in the declaration docstring.

Use the natural Ext-to-derived-global-sections isomorphism, computed using the same injective resolutions, to transfer the derived image cocone colimit to the image cocone under Sheaf.functorH. Naturality identifies all the cocone legs.

    (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
